notes: Note issued at face because the 6% stated rate equals the 6% market rate, so no premium/discount; stated interest = 80,000 x 6% = 4,800 collected each Dec 31. Impairment at 12/31/Y1 is measured as carrying amount 80,000 less the PV of the ONLY expected cash flow (54,000 due 12/31/Y4) discounted 3 periods at the ORIGINAL effective rate of 6%: 54,000 / 1.06^3 = 45,339 (matches the given PV: True); the current 12% similar-risk rate is ignored for discounting per the requirement. Impairment loss = 34,661, credited to a valuation allowance so gross Notes Receivable stays at 80,000. After impairment the net carrying amount accretes at 6% each period with the offset debited to the allowance and credited to Interest Revenue (no cash interest is expected): Y2 2,720; Y3 2,884; Y4 3,057. The schedule ties exactly: net CA reaches 54,000 and the allowance falls to 26,000 (= 80,000 - 54,000) at 12/31/Y4 (schedule ties: True). Because 54,000 is collected exactly as expected, no gain or loss arises; the combined settlement entry debits Cash 54,000 and the remaining allowance 29,057 (26,000 residual + 3,057 Year 4 accretion), credits Interest Revenue 3,057 and Notes Receivable 80,000.
